column3:
A surprisingly unsinged Lydirceil is eager to proceed.
※Changing classes or jobs will prevent progress during this quest.

Though Lydirceil is keen to see your phantom weapon stripped of its illusory trappings, Gerolt is already having misgivings. Despite the success of the previous test, the weaponsmith divulges that he noticed a slight aetherial imbalance in Lydirceil's armor resulting from the Phantom Philleter. Leery of leaving the issue unaddressed, Gerolt resolves to rebuild the core of your weapon and thus counteract any discrepancies. Sadly, this requires three chunks of ecliptic arcanite, and, presumably, a significant outlay of tomestones. Once you have completed the transaction, Dodokkuli will be waiting to receive the ore for initial processing.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

※Chunks of ecliptic arcanite can be obtained from Ermina in the phantom village.

The diminutive metallurgist deftly completes his preparations and hands the processed ore to Gerolt. Brandishing the knife with enthusiasm, the grizzled weaponsmith slices through the illusion wreathing your phantom weapon. Although the weapon's true form has been revealed, Gerolt is determined to “squeeze every last drop o' potential” out of his creation, and bids you channel memories of battle into it to help him achieve his vision. Exactly what he means by this, however, remains to be seen...
Obtain chunks of ecliptic arcanite.
Quite the demonstration that was, eh?
As much as I enjoyed the sight of your companion wreathed in magical flames, I thought it best to extinguish him before the mischief spiraled out of control...

Phew! I was startin' to worry I'd be ablaze forever... Anyroad, we best see about gettin' yer phantom weapon stripped of its illusory magicks an' elevated to new 'eights.
Please note that upon completing the quest “A Phantom Unveiled,” you will receive a phantom weapon for an .
What will you do?
Undertake this quest as another job.
Undertake this quest as an .
Please speak with Lydirceil again when you are ready to undertake this quest.
All set? Let's get crackin'.
I thought I was...but I noticed somethin' durin' our experiment that's got me contemplatin' one last modification.

When I sliced through the glamour earlier, yer armor's aetherial balance shifted slightly askew. At first I didn't pay it much heed, but on reflection, there's no tellin' how the phantom weapon'll react.
So here's me plan: reformulate the weapon's core to channel aether into a single focal point. That'll negate the minor imbalance caused by the Philleter, an' ensure the weapon attains its true form.
Another bleedin' step?
Quit yer bellyachin'! Besides, I've already figured out what materials we'll need.
The surveyors've dug up a new ore they're callin' ecliptic arcanite, and it just so happens the stuff's ideal for rebuildin' phantom weapon cores.
'Fraid ye'll have to deal with Ermina again for the ore. Once ye've got three chunks, 'and 'em to Dodokkuli for processin'.
Dodokkuli's standin' by to process the ore as soon as ye get yer 'ands on some. Gerolt doesn't bother 'imself with the grunt work these days, ye see.
Chunks of ecliptic arcanite can be obtained from Ermina in the phantom village.
If yer wonderin' why I didn't mention the ore earlier, it's 'cause I didn't know we'd need the bleedin' stuff until that demonstration. Unexpected setbacks are all part an' parcel o' weaponsmithin'.
I admire Gerolt's dedication to his craft! Lesser artisans would have simply waved away a minor aetheric imbalance, but not he!
Before Gerolt can begin rebuilding the core of your phantom weapon, I shall need to process the ecliptic arcanite. Have you procured all three chunks?
Have you procured the necessary ore? Be sure to unequip your phantom weapon before we begin.
After handing over the requisite ecliptic arcanite, the core of your phantom weapon will be completely rebuilt.
However, please note that any affixed materia will be lost in the process.
Excellent. I'll soon have the ore ready. The remainder of the fabrication I shall leave in Gerolt's capable hands.
Take heart, for we are tantalizingly close to seeing your weapon released from its illusory cloak!
Right, yer phantom weapon's got a shiny new core. If me calculations are right, that'll prevent any aetheric imbalances once I cut through the illusion.
In other words, it's phantom philletin' time!
MUAHAHAHAHAHA!
Well, that was a resoundin' success. I sliced right through yer weapon's illusory trappin's, leavin' all the enhancements intact.
Behold the true, unfettered power o' me latest creation: !
Behold the true, unfettered power o' me latest creations:  an' !
Suffice it to say, these gods-given hands have wrought another bleedin' miracle.

Ye might've turned to ancient wisdom for inspiration, but in the end, it was that brilliant rum-brined brain o' yers that made the real advances. I reckon it's fair to say yer the best damned blacksmith of our age!
“Of our age,” eh?
Fittin' that me creations are wielded by the fiercest fighter of our times, then! Say, here's an idea: why don't ye channel some o' yer most valiant memories o' battle into that phantom weapon?
I'll be damned if I don't try an' squeeze every last drop o' potential out o' the thing, an' I reckon yer memories are key to achievin' me vision!
Further enhanced phantom weapons for other jobs can now be obtained after exchanging the requisite ecliptic arcanite with Dodokkuli in the phantom village.
